messages:
Maria R.: Quick sync — we need a short decision on the Dedicated surge policy before next week's customer review. TL;DR: propose a ruleset that gives committed pools a soft-preempt band (10% headroom) + an emergency preempt window for safety-critical tenants.
Alex P.: +1 for soft band. question: how do we measure "safety-critical"? a tag on the tenant object? :thinking_face: 
Jordan L.: We already have a priority tag in the onboarding flow. can be used, but ops wants a human override via the onboarding ticket.
Sam T.: Ops concern: if soft-preempt is 10% we still need an observable eviction signal and a clear customer-facing SLA note. otherwise they'll be surprised.
Maria R.: Agreed. Proposal = soft band 10%, preempt only after 3min sustained overcommit, alert to oncall, then 60s graceful drain. If tenant priority==critical, skip soft band and try to fall through to fallback region first.
Olivia (oncall): +1 on the 3min hysteresis. add runbook step: oncall should trigger immediate rollback if >2 customer incidents within 1hr.
Alex P.: How about billing/credits? if we preempt, do we credit back burst tokens or count as overage? need to be clear in contract.
Jordan L.: For GA we should credit partial burst for involuntary preemption. Maybe 50% of spilled tokens refunded as credit. keep legal in loop.
Sam T.: Implementation note: autoscaler needs a new metric 'sustained_headroom_violation' that increments when demand > pool_capacity for seq=180s. will need a rollout plan.
Maria R.: Launch criteria checklist draft: 1) ruleset implemented in autoscaler and gate config 2) telemetry for headroom_violation + eviction_reason 3) billing credit flow prototyped 4) runbook and customer-facing doc 5) two pilot customers signed up.
Alex P.: Timeline? can we target pilot rollout in 3 sprints (~6 weeks) if eng-priority green?
Jordan L.: Realistic: 3 sprints if we cut scope: MVP = soft band enforcement + telemetry + runbook. billing prototype in parallel, GA later.
Olivia (oncall): Ops reqs: add an internal dashboard widget for preempt events and a dedicated alert channel (#prod-preempt-alerts).
Maria R.: Action items: @Alex P to own autoscaler changes (due EOD Fri: sketch PR), @Sam T to spec metric and dashboard, @Jordan L to draft contract language for preempt credits, @Olivia to draft runbook. I'll coordinate pilot outreach.
capacity-bot: Reminder: weekly cadence meeting scheduled Fri 10:00AM for capacity roadmap.
Alex P.: I'll post a short RFC in /docs next week with the pseudocode for the hysteresis logic. sample: ``` if sustained_headroom_violation >= 180s: trigger_soft_preempt(target_pct=10, drain_window=60s) ```
Sam T.: small ask — include an opt-out flag for customers who absolutely refuse preempt, we should surface pricing for that.
Maria R.: Good call. opt-out will be part of Dedicated purchase flow (higher price, contractual). include in pilot checklist.
Jordan L.: OK. If no objections by EOD Friday, I'll move the soft-band + 3min hysteresis to product requirements doc and schedule a pilot kickoff.
Maria R.: No objections from me. thanks everyone — will follow up with a concrete PR + tracking ticket. :rocket:
